hook: Hollywood CGI or one Seedance 2.5 prompt?
caption:
Hollywood CGI or one Seedance 2.5 prompt?

The creator says one prompt made this whole street fight, camera moves included.

Hollywood still needs a crew, a location and weeks for a shot like this. So the camera move is the fairest test of one prompt against a full crew. Who wins? Vote in the comments 👇

Send this to the friend who still thinks Hollywood can't be beaten.

Credit: @lexx_aura on X

checked: Seedance 2.5 is ByteDance's video model, released 2026-07-31 (https://technode.com/2026/07/31/bytedance-launches-seedance-2-5-video-generation-model/, one search, not ByteDance's own page)
Tool name and 'Hollywood CGI' framing taken from the post text in the owner brief; https://x.com/lexx_aura/status/2109031963701158183 returned HTTP 402 when fetched, so the post was not re-read

Frames 1-8 (runs/clip-20261014-131517-01158183/frames/): street fight, blonde figure in black suit vs long-haired figure, tracking camera, motion blur; frame 1 has Japanese/Chinese subtitles, so the source may be film footage. Unverified: the Seedance claim rests on the creator's post alone
